title: Demonstrator End to End All Apps
description: Get the Entwerfen-mit-Bestand demonstrator working end to end with all six app panes: every window shows the correct fixture, is interactive, and is version controlled.
summary: Server boots (HTTP 200) and the landing page renders after fixing three blockers: the half-landed reactor NativeCloseKey migration (framework did not compile for wasm32-wasip2), a bare JSON import that killed the repo's whole Playwright infrastructure, and a wasm-pack stderr-pipe crash on the warning flood. Document round-trip and TiledMap selection/hover also fixed. New 7-test acceptance suite runs live: 1 passed, 6 failed — all six panes fail on ONE framework panic (interactive-job.catalog-authority, tool 'setLocale', expected.contains(tool_id)==false). Goal NOT met: no window renders its fixture. Next step and full evidence in 📓️status.md.
